cc:Work.dc:title: WallMounted - WallWrenchHolder
cc:Work.dc:description:
Hold a set of wrenches at a wall
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes WallWrenchHolder --thickness 3 --burn 0.1 --walltype dinrail --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes WallWrenchHolder --walltype --reference --labels
